headings.usage: Use for all screen titles, total balance numbers, and primary data points.

body.usage: Use for list items, descriptions, labels, and secondary text.

components.cards: Cardless feeling where possible. If a card is needed, use solid background (surface color) with a 1px border. No drop shadows. For the Total Net Worth card, use the abstract texture background.
components.buttons: Pill shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons have high contrast (White bg in dark mode, Black bg in light mode). Active scale down on press.
components.chips: For member multi-select and filters. Unselected: surface background, text muted. Selected: inverted (primary background, primaryText color).
components.charts: Line graphs must have smooth monotone X curves. Use a subtle linear gradient fill under the line extending to the bottom of the chart.
components.forms: Inputs should have large tap targets (min height 48px). Floating labels or clear bold labels outside. Subtle borders, focus state highlights border with primary color.
components.bottom_tab_bar: Floating pill design or border-t only with clear active/inactive icon states.

icons: lucide-react-native or @expo/vector-icons. Prefer minimal, stroke-based icons (strokeWidth 1.5).

images.description: Premium dark abstract waves for the Total Net Worth summary card in dark mode.
Premium light abstract waves for the Total Net Worth summary card in light mode.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a testID attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid) formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo app utilizing .js files (no TypeScript). Translate styling guidelines into NativeWind classes or React Native StyleSheet objects.
Strictly adhere to the dark/light mode color palette provided. Implement theming carefully.
Use 'testID' instead of 'data-testid' for all interactive elements like buttons, inputs, and list items, e.g., testID='login-submit-button'.
For the main 'Total Net Worth' dashboard card, use the provided abstract wave textures via an ImageBackground to give a premium credit-card feel.
Implement the line chart for investments using react-native-chart-kit or react-native-gifted-charts with smooth curves and gradient fills.
Keep spacing generous (padding 24px/p-6, gaps 16px/gap-4) to maintain the premium, uncluttered look.
Do not use generic blue/purple colors; stick to the high-contrast monochrome + emerald/rose scheme.
Ensure all text has adequate contrast ratios.
Ensure all modules (Auth, Members, Transactions, Investments, Loans, Reports) follow this consistent clean card-based and list-based UI pattern.
